text:
The co-inventor was most likely Katharine B. Blodgett, the General Electric scientist known for thin monomolecular film coatings and non-reflective glass. I'm picking her over Irving Langmuir partly because of the team note's hint. I also have a weak recollection that her patent list includes an electrical indicator of mechanical expansion with Schaefer. I'm withdrawing my earlier guess of Bernard Vonnegut.

CONFIDENCE: 78
